title: Revising Plans After Field Evidence
description: CAT 531 textbook section connecting revising plans after field evidence to field-placement transfer note connecting tool choice to classroom constraints, reader notes, support moments, and revision evidence.
learning_objectives: Read field evidence to isolate which component of a plan failed, rather than defending or scrapping the whole.
Distinguish a design flaw from a context mismatch (laziness versus an access barrier).
Document a bounded AI/software support move, including an AI reframing you rejected because it ignored the real cause.
Show evidence-based revision: original plan, prompting data, targeted change, and follow-up data.
